description: ⚠️ RESULTS ARE PAGINATED. PRIVATE PREVIEW.  THE ACCOUNT MUST BE ALLOWLISTED TO USE THIS FEATURE. Retrieve all active warnings for a connection, grouped by destination table. Each warning includes a code, message, error details, and creation timestamp.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the connection. Retrieve it from the `id` field in the [List All Connections](https://fivetran.com/docs/rest-api/api-reference/connections/list-connections) response, or from the `id` field returned when you [Create a Connection](https://fivetran.com/docs/rest-api/api-reference/connections/create-connection).

items.description: Array of warnings grouped by destination table

schema.description: The destination schema name. Omitted for warnings that are not scoped to a specific table.

table.description: The destination table name. Omitted for warnings that are not scoped to a specific table.

warnings.description: List of warnings for this table

code.description: A machine-readable identifier for the condition type. Use this value to programmatically detect and respond to specific connection conditions.

message.description: A human-readable label describing the condition. For example: Reconnect, Resync Table Warning.

error_message.description: Additional error details extracted from the warning

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the warning was created

next_cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results
